items.title: Microsoft, Musk Race to Reinvent the AI Chip
items.title_ko: Microsoft, Musk Race to Reinvent the AI Chip
items.summary_ko: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Microsoft's latest homegrown Maia chips, its latest effort to rely less on outside semiconductors to power its AI ambitions. Plus, Elon Musk wants to put chip development on fast-forward, testing as many as ten new designs a year; and Apple is finally ready to unveil its new smart home strategy, seeking to plug a major hole in its ecosystem.
